name: ClickPlay Video Slider
author: DARGPY

sections.description:
ClickPlay Video Slider adds a block to the WordPress editor that displays several YouTube videos in a carousel.

Most video sliders load one YouTube player for every video as soon as the page opens, which slows your site down. ClickPlay Video Slider shows a lightweight thumbnail instead and loads the real player only when a visitor clicks on it.

Features

  • Lightweight loading: thumbnails first, the video loads on click.
  • Uses youtube-nocookie.com for the player.
  • Choose how many videos to show per page on desktop, tablet and mobile.
  • Accepts watch, youtu.be, embed, shorts and live links.
  • Optional carousel title and video titles.
  • Accent color setting for buttons, dots and title.
  • Reorder videos right in the editor.
  • Accessible: keyboard-friendly buttons and screen reader labels.
  • Styles that respect your theme: no heavy CSS framework required.
  • Scripts and styles are only loaded on pages that use the block.
  • Translation ready.

External services

This plugin uses YouTube, a service provided by Google, to display videos.

  • When a slider is shown, the visitor’s browser loads each video’s thumbnail image from i.ytimg.com. The visitor’s IP address and browser information are sent to that server.
  • When a visitor clicks a video, the YouTube player is loaded from www.youtube-nocookie.com. Google receives the visitor’s IP address and browser information and may process data as described in its policies.

The plugin itself does not collect, store or send any data to the plugin author.

Service provider: Google LLC (YouTube).
Terms of Service: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the clickplay-video-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin from the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen.
  3. In the editor, add the “ClickPlay Video Slider” block.
  4. Paste your YouTube links, set the number of videos per page and publish.
sections.faq:
Does the video load automatically?

No. Only the thumbnail is loaded at first. The YouTube player loads when the visitor clicks the play button, which keeps your pages fast.

Which YouTube links can I use?

Regular watch links, short youtu.be links, embed links, Shorts and live links. You can also paste the 11-character video ID.

Can I change the colors and the title size?

You can pick an accent color in the block settings. The carousel title uses your theme’s heading style, so you can adjust its size with your theme or with custom CSS using the .cpvs-title class.

Does it work with page builders and classic themes?

It is a block, so it works wherever the block editor is available.
